close_reason: Profiled mount with Erlang call-time tracing; web builder state updates were a major hot path. Replaced its transient maps with tuples while retaining identical HTML/diff/fingerprints. First matched full run: 1000-row mount 4831.6 -> 4136.3 us, caller allocation 0.96x. Direct-target hypothesis captured separately as flm-9hx; repeat full measurement follows formatting cleanup.
description: The first full matched run in bench/baselines/comparison-117ddfa.md shows render/mount at 1000 rows increasing from 3335.1 us to 4831.6 us (1.45x) and caller allocations 1.21x. Pure rendering/keyed jobs allocate about 12–36% more across tested sizes. Reproduce full baseline commands in bench/README.md with identical runtime/harness and repeat before optimizing. Profile Reconciler mount, vnode construction and Web.to_rendered separately; identify intermediate allocations and repeated traversal rather than guessing from elapsed time. Preserve equivalent encoded-diff output correctness, keyed fiber retention, lifecycle and event behavior. Implement a measured optimization in a separate commit, run tests/Credo/Dialyzer and all fixture checks, then compare matched full reports and document tradeoffs including diff bytes.
title: Profile vnode mount cost and rendering allocations against main baseline
